mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past 4 months indicates a broad-based demand contraction that triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline in past 4 months
failure_condition: Forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of industrial production growth above 1.0% year-over-year, robust supply chain conditions expand corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening consumer confidence and residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, persistent inflation prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) over the past 3 months indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise in past 3 months
failure_condition: Forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained), increased real interest rates compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
